summary: RFC-0062 OQ-1: runWorkerPool, evaluateSchedule and the SubscriptionLedger (RFC-0010 s14) are deleted under the dark-code gate; the pacer gains a budget-pressure priority floor

options.description: Delete the three modules; the pacer claims only tasks at or above a priority floor while the budget projects past 100% before reset
Adapt board manifests and pacer windows to the RFC-0010 s14 pool and ledger types
Delete; BUDGET cap stays the only control
Keep exported for a multi-host worker

body: Full rubric in RFC-0062 OQ-1 resolution (2026-11-06). Three RFC-0010 s14 modules implement quota-aware scheduling but nothing on the live hierarchy path calls them; the live quota control is the pacer. Options weighed: wire the modules into claim order (two quota sources that drift); delete with no replacement (pacer stays priority-blind); keep exported for RFC-0060 (undated); delete and add one rule to the pacer.
